snippet.title: Forgotten 23 – Launch Date Revealed! #indiegame
snippet.description:
Hey everyone!
I’m incredibly excited to announce that Forgotten 23 will launch July 18 this year! 🎉 #indiegame #indiedev 

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815080/Forgotten_23/

I have been working hard on this project for the past 1.5 years and together - with the publisher indie.io - I can't wait to finally share my new game with you!

This adventure follows you as astronaut Max Novak as he faces strange anomalies on the abandoned research station "Forgotten" located in orbit around the planet Proxima Centauri b.
Confront station anomalies in 23-minute time loops.
Collect items and create the necessary repair parts.
Solve puzzles in computers and station terminals.
Find information about the crew and learn all the secrets of the station…
but be careful... you only have 23 minutes every loop before the station crashes into the planet.

It was an incredible adventure for me - working every day from Monday to Friday at a "day job" -  every afternoon and every weekend I sat down and made Forgotten 23 - from the idea, through drawings, station planning, characters, history, dialogues, the entire plot and… sleepless nights and hectoliters of coffee ;) 

It's an incredible feeling when the game is ready. Incredible pride in having made something from scratch, from idea to full release. For you. For the players.

Make sure to add the game to your wishlist to stay up to date with all the latest updates.

Thanks so much for your support, and see you soon in Forgotten 23!
